edges.description: FM-13 is the first explicit retrieval-relevance diagnosis stage, instrumenting the active path before any model or runtime gate was changed.
FM-14 is the bounded real-embedding differential that tested whether semantic geometry alone removed the Zephyr relevance failure.
FM-15 isolates local CrossEncoder pairwise scoring so scorer signal can be studied without changing the stock search recipe or runtime gate.
FM-16 is the closed held-out mixed-query experiment separating ranking quality from the feasibility of one absolute global qualification threshold.
FM-13 showed the CrossEncoder was not invoked and deterministic embeddings shaped the cosine channel, motivating a one-variable real-embedding test.
Real embeddings improved semantic geometry but Zephyr still returned unrelated facts, motivating direct measurement of a stronger query↔fact pairwise scorer.
FM-15 confirmed useful pairwise CE signal on a tiny fixture but no generalization or threshold, motivating held-out entity-disjoint global-threshold feasibility testing.
FM-16 closed the generic raw-score threshold question for the frozen mixed task and exposed the residual qualification error class that FM-17-pre is designed to diagnose structurally.
The run_007 artifact directory is the exact frozen evidence source for FM-16 scores, thresholds, receipts and numerical outputs.
The closure document reconciles later independent reviews and narrows ambiguous raw labels while remaining subordinate to frozen artifacts for exact numerical facts.
The 2026-09-10 track snapshot remains useful history through FM-15 and protocol hardening, but its current-frontier statement that FM-16 had not run is superseded by the run_007 closure.
FM-13 made the Zephyr no-answer case observable: retrieval returned all stored facts even though the frozen relevance gold was empty.
Zephyr demonstrates why relative ranking needs a reject-all possibility: best available candidate does not imply relevant memory exists in the tested candidate set.
FM-16 shows one global raw threshold cannot jointly satisfy the frozen mixed-query constraints; this leaves Honest Empty open rather than establishing it.
Later inspection of FM-15 Q5 showed that co-retrieved intermediate facts can be required components without being direct-answer gold, forcing role separation in later protocols.
FM-16 hardened primary evaluation around direct-answer relevance while keeping Q5-like multi-hop components separate from the global-threshold gold contract.
FM-17-pre explicitly protects DIRECT_ANSWER, MULTI_HOP_COMPONENT, RELATED_CONTEXT and NONANSWER so structural filtering cannot win by deleting necessary components.
FM-17-pre may measure whether oracle structure contributes to qualification, but it is not itself an executed or solved Honest Empty mechanism.
